notes: Conference paper (IOP Conf. Ser.: Mater. Sci. Eng. 368, 012031) with original data. H2 uptake is measured only for AC4 (Section 3.2: 'only AC4 ... were considered for hydrogen storage analysis'): low pressure up to 1 bar on a Micromeritics ASAP 2020 HD88, high pressure up to 8 MPa on a VTI HPVA-100 that the paper calls a gravimetric analyzer; both at 77 K, Figure 3a/3b show the isotherms. Maxsorb-3 values (5.8 and 2.1 wt.%) are given in Section 3.3 without a statement that they were measured here. Minor internal inconsistencies (abstract 3508 m2/g and 6.8 wt.% versus Table 1 3503 m2/g and text 6.7 wt.%; 4 MPa in text versus 40 bar in Table 2) do not affect eligibility. Not a review; is_retracted is false and the PDF shows no retraction notice; the paper does not state that its H2 uptake values were published before (Table 2 lists other authors' values with references), so duplicate_data does not apply.
